commit_message:
Add constant evaluation support for the `struct.new[_default]` Wasm GC instructions (#9282)

* Add constant evaluation support for the `struct.new[_default]` Wasm GC instructions

* fix no-gc builds

* wrap const evaluation in `AutoAssertNoGc`

* add assertions that we access `VMGcRef`s in native-endian

* fix an endian mismatch bug between compiled wasm code and host code

findings.title: GC struct allocation error reaches a pre-existing unchecked const-eval result
findings.message: This change lets a module-supplied constant expression allocate a GC struct. StructRef::_new can fail, so eval now returns an allocation error for this input. The already-existing global initializer calls eval(...).expect(...); it panics instead of returning that error to the embedder.

location.description: New fallible GC allocation reachable during const-expression evaluation

related_locations.description: Pre-existing panic on any const-eval error during global initialization

findings.suggestion: Propagate const-eval failures from the global initializer instead of unwrapping them.

ground_truth.root_cause: A newly reachable fallible GC allocation was added to const-expression evaluation without changing the existing caller's unconditional expect on the result.
